_comment: MACF Engine Schedule Manifest (Oct 10, 2026). Declares every recurring job the engine requires to stay functional. The install script (install-schedules.sh) ensures each exists; check-schedules.js verifies and self-heals. If a job is listed here but not scheduled, that is a defect — the TDD suite fails.

schedules.purpose: Calls each agent's runAutonomous() hourly to generate verifiable artifacts. Without this, agents go silent and the sprint-demo-check flags them. (Root-caused Oct 9, 2026: script existed but was never scheduled.)
schedules.title: Autonomous agent hourly driver

schedules.purpose: Scans #management and #marketing for [from: CEO → Role] messages and routes to agents. The Railway bot's LLM path is down; the VM handles directives directly.
schedules.title: CEO directive poller

schedules.purpose: Enforces Jesse's law: every agent with active tasks must produce verifiable demo output hourly. Includes demo relay to Jesse.
schedules.title: Hourly sprint demo check

schedules.purpose: Checks active tasks, flags stale tasks, reports deliveries. Monitoring only — never marks tasks done.
schedules.title: Vikunja team delivery monitor

schedules.purpose: Supervises the engine process, restarts if down, self-heals VM snapshot damage. Runs check-schedules.js for schedule self-healing.
schedules.title: MACF engine watchdog

schedules.purpose: Autonomous repair layer: diagnoses failure modes, applies fixes, verifies with tests.
schedules.title: MACF self-healer

schedules.purpose: Catches silent directive threads before Jesse has to ask. Nudges owners with verified facts; escalates to Jesse if still silent.
schedules.title: CEO directive watch

schedules.purpose: Scores agent messages on delivery evidence, learns patterns, tracks per-agent quality.
schedules.title: Delivery quality learner

schedules.purpose: Refreshes Canva and Buffer OAuth tokens on desktop, syncs to VM. Keeps MCP integrations alive.
schedules.title: MCP token refresh
Ticket triage — auto-assign new tickets
schedules.purpose: Monitors Vikunja for unassigned tasks every 15 min. Urgent tasks assigned immediately to appropriate agent; normal tasks assigned to execPM for sprint planning. (Built Oct 10, 2026 — Jesse: no ticket should sit unassigned.)

schedules.title: Hourly Scrum Standup
schedules.purpose: Hourly team standup (Cockburn Scrum): 3 questions — done last hour, plan next hour, blockers. execPM as scrum master. Posts to #management for osmotic communication.

schedules.title: Sprint Planning (12h)
schedules.purpose: 12-hour sprint planning: review completed work, prioritize Vikunja backlog (max 3), set sprint goal. Cockburn: frequent delivery, focus.

schedules.title: Sprint Review & Retrospective (12h)
schedules.purpose: 12-hour sprint review + retrospective: demo completed work to Jesse, reflect on what worked/didn't, feed improvements to improvement loop. Cockburn: reflective improvement.

schedules.title: Release Planning (48h)
schedules.purpose: Every 4 sprints: review velocity, prioritize user stories with points/acceptance criteria, set release goal. Cockburn: frequent delivery at release cadence.
